description: On-chain passports that list what an AI agent is allowed to do, on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). initialize_passport, update_permissions and close_passport were verified, and stranger updates, stranger closes, empty scopes and over-long labels were rejected.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of michaelmazilu/nomad. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/nomad. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (passport lifecycle and validation)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/nomad-passport/
QA: devnet proof of passport updates and authority checks
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Write a client that enforces a passport scope before acting
